headline: Finland orders halt to two Google data centres over environmental lapses
summary: Finland temporarily halted Google's work on two planned data centres after it failed to carry out required environmental impact assessments; reports say forest land was cleared beforehand. The sites are part of a larger, multi-site Google data centre investment in Finland.

claims.statement: Finland ordered Google to temporarily halt construction on two data centre sites over missing environmental impact assessments.

sources.quote: Finland orders halt to work on two Google data centres
Google told to halt work on datacentres in Finland over environmental concerns

claims.statement: Reports say forest land at the site was cleared before the required environmental assessment was obtained.

sources.quote: cleared over 300 hectares of forest before obtaining a mandatory environmental impact assessment
Google failed to carry out environmental impact assessments

claims.statement: The halted sites are part of a larger, multi-billion-euro Google data centre buildout across northern Finland.
